data.title: Maximum and mean response latency per service
data.description: Read the application log. The service is the third whitespace-separated field of each line; some lines end with a field "latency_ms=<integer>" (e.g. "2026-03-05T14:00:01Z INFO svc-api GET /v1/items latency_ms=120"). Use only lines that carry a latency_ms field, whatever their level; ignore the rest. Return "latency", a mapping of service to {"max": the largest latency as an integer, "mean": the arithmetic mean rounded with round(x, 2)}; "slowest_service", the service with the largest max (ties broken by the alphabetically smallest name); and "samples", the number of latency values used.
